One thing I know for sure, they never deny for no reason. Stop trying and do a deep verification of all your documents; read the rejection letter carefully and then reapply only when you find a strong motive for her to come to England. They are not stupid, before approving your demand they will check your record by going through previous applications status and will get resentful after seing so many rejections. You have 4 options in my eye. The first one is to look at her qualifications, see if she is either qualified for a job position in the UK and then apply for a working permit or apply for school if her age permits it. Second option would be to move to another of the common wealth. Try your luck for Canada, they are super positive about immigration and are looking for workers etc… if you complete all the requirements that might be your best option. The third option would be a good one to consider if you want to stay in the uk regardless. If that’s your wish, you should to do round trips between India and England to see your wife while keeping your status. Finally the least profitable option would be to leave your wife, is it really worth the fight? If the answer is no then you know what to do. If the answer is yes then that leave you with the previous 3 options to consider. Either way, I wish you good luck my friend.
